build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF model
sample_crf_model: sample training data from a linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding on random inputs
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequence graphs
train_linear_crf: train a linear-chain CRF model using SGD with gradient-based parameter updates on sample data
